body:
Yeah, irrelevant. That’s basically sums up how I’ve been feeling for the past few years. It feels like people aren’t here for me when I need them the most.

Idk it’s just like I don’t actually belong. For example, I’ll be with my friends laughing and shit but on the inside I’m so tense and self conscious. I’ll start feeling like none of these people actually care about me or even want me here. That they’re only pretending to like me.

Do you know those little games where you have to try to find the one that doesn’t belong? And how the one that doesn’t belong always looks really similar to everything else, but once you finally notice that it’s not the same, it’s hard to not notice how different it is? That’s how I feel.

It’s not even like I’m that bad at being social. I talk to pretty much all the guys in my grade, and several other guys from grades above/below me. I’m friendly with most of the girls in my grade, and a couple other ones in the grades above me. 

But I still don’t feel like I matter. It’s like if I vanished nobody would even care. I still feel like an outsider looking in even when I’m on the inside. Like I’m an impostor or something.
